heading: טאָמאַשעוו[פ]סקי, באָריס [ברוך-אהרן]
evidence: entry says he sang in Berdichev aged 11 in 1879; Zylbercweig's own note calls 1886 a misprint for 1868 (cited in en.wikipedia Boris_Thomashefsky); the 1886 date dropped him from candidate lists by the birth gate

heading: קאַמינסקי, אַברהם יצחק
evidence: text reads 1887, impossible: same entry has him forming an amateur group in 1887, marrying 1893, 20-year stage jubilee 1907; probably 1867 but no source read, so left blank

heading: בערנשטיין, בערל [בורשטין]
evidence: entry reads דעם 29טן אויגוסט 1992; impossible against b. בערך 1860 (age 132) and vol 1. The 9 is an OCR misread of 0: 1902. Day and month are legible and kept; he died in New York after a cancer operation, as the entry's closing lines say.

heading: אַמאַסיאַ, הערש
evidence: entry reads דעם 98 מאי 1827 — the day-of-month '98' shows the whole date is garbled. b. 1864, so 1827 is 37 years before birth. 1927 is confirmed independently: his memoirs appeared in יידיש טעאַטער, Warsaw, 1927, cited in the same entry. Day unrecoverable, so month precision only.

heading: ברוין, דוד
evidence: entry reads 7 סעפּטעמבער 1967, after his stated 1945 death. Entry has him self-taught in German/Russian, writing Yiddish songs at 15, working as a weaver, and emigrating to America in 1903 — all requiring an 1860s birth. 9 misread for 8: 1867.

heading: פישקינד, אַברהם
evidence: entry reads 26 אויגוסט 1962, after his stated 1940 death. He sang for the Kherson cantor as a boy, reached the Yiddish stage at 18, and joined Adler and Rozenberg's Kherson troupe in 1881 — so 1862, not 1962. 9 misread for 8.

heading: דוליצקאיא, מאניאַ,
evidence: entry reads געבוירן בערך 1020 אין באקו — a 4-digit year missing its century. She finished the Moscow Yiddish theatre school in 1941 and was killed at the front in 1942, so 1920. Approximation (בערך) preserved as ~.

heading: נוסינאָוו, יצחק
evidence: no death date in the entry at all: it gives b. 14 July 1889 and ends on a 12 March 1932 Moscow production. The 1831-11-29 is fabricated, and 58 years before his birth. Blanked rather than guessed — it was propagating into 7 OUTSIDE_LIFE edges.
